description:
Correct the document command reference for the versions `jit doc show` reads and for what `jit doc history` lists.

## Background

- `docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2856` says an unpinned `jit doc show` reads the committed tree at `HEAD` when git exists, so an uncommitted derived file cannot be shown. An unpinned show now reads the working tree.
- `docs/reference/cli-commands.md:2862` describes `jit doc history`, which now follows git's history of the path, including the commit that deleted it and omitting merges identical to a parent.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The reference states that `jit doc show` reads an unpinned document from the working tree and a pinned or `--at` read at that commit, and that an uncommitted derived document can be shown.
- [hard] REQ-02: The reference states that `jit doc history` lists git's history of the path, including the commit that deleted it.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Document command reference states the show and history semantics
